_comment: Quotation job for REFCON (Refrigerated Containers Industrial Co.), Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
Enquiry via business card of Eng. Tariq Dweik, Senior Sales Engineer, 2026-09-21.
Buyer identification: the card is the only source used. refcon.sa was checked and is
currently COMPROMISED (webshell banner, gambling spam), so nothing from it was trusted;
the only cross-check it provided is the switchboard number, which matches the card.
The hacked site prints P.O. Box 608 while the card prints 609 - the card wins.
Products matched from the client's own photos to catalogue records:
photo 2 (black body, red bar, top+bottom rods) -> 330
photo 3 (silver bar on a white sandwich-panel door) -> 302
photos 4-5 (black outside lever with euro cylinder) -> 016 exterior trim
The '3 points' wording is the client's, taken from their message and visible in the
photos; the catalogue records do not state a point count, so it is not invented here.
Prices are the client's: 18.90 for the red & black 3-point, 10.44 for the second item.
See the OPEN QUESTION note - which item 10.44 belongs to is not certain from the brief.

notes: OPEN QUESTION - please confirm before we send this: USD 10.44 is quoted here against the 302 silver three-point bar. If that price was meant for the outside lever trim instead, tell us and we reissue.
At the 300 pcs MOQ shown, the order value is USD 8,802 - below USD 10,000, so EXW Zhongshan would apply. FOB China needs an order value of USD 10,000 or more.
The black outside lever trim with cylinder in your photos is our 016 exterior trim. It is not priced above; tell us the quantity and we will add it.
For your cold-room and insulated-panel doors we also make 317, a low-profile push bar and latch built for that application - worth a look alongside these two.
Bar lengths are made to the door. Please send door height, leaf width and panel thickness and we will confirm the exact configuration.
